map.通过逐步选择症状，缩小可能疾病范围，给出就诊建议: Narrow down possible conditions step by step through symptom choices and get visit advice
map.⚠️ 郑重声明：本工具仅供参考，不构成医疗建议，如有不适请及时就医！: ⚠️ Important notice: this tool is for reference only and does not constitute medical advice. If you feel unwell, seek medical attention promptly!
map.选择主要症状所属区域: Select the area of the main symptom
map.根据提示逐步回答问题（每步2-4个选项）: Answer the questions step by step as prompted (2-4 options per step)
map.系统将根据回答缩小可能疾病范围: The system narrows the range of possible conditions based on your answers
map.最终给出可能疾病、建议就诊科室和注意事项: Finally gives possible conditions, recommended departments and precautions
map.呼吸道：普通感冒、流感、支气管炎、肺炎: Respiratory: common cold, flu, bronchitis, pneumonia
map.消化道：急性肠胃炎、食物中毒、胃炎: Digestive: acute gastroenteritis, food poisoning, gastritis
map.头部：偏头痛、紧张性头痛、高血压预警: Head: migraine, tension headache, hypertension warning

map.关于症状自查决策树: About the Symptom Self-Check Decision Tree
map.症状自查决策树通过交互式问答方式，帮助用户初步了解症状可能对应的疾病方向，提供就: The Symptom Self-Check Decision Tree uses interactive questions to help users get a preliminary idea of which conditions a symptom may point to, and provides suggested departments and precautions for reference.
map.逐步缩小诊断范围: Narrow the diagnostic range step by step
map.初步了解症状可能原因: Get a preliminary idea of possible causes
map.判断是否需要立即就医: Judge whether immediate care is needed
map.选择合适就诊科室: Choose the right department to visit
map.选择症状类别逐步自查：先选大类（如发热、头痛、腹痛、咳嗽等），工具以决策树逐题提: Self-check step by step by symptom category: first pick a broad category (e.g. fever, headache, abdominal pain, cough), and the tool asks one question at a time along the decision tree, branching to the next node based on your answers until it gives the possible conditions.
map.输出可能疾病与就诊科室：走到叶子节点后，显示「可能情况、建议就诊科室、注意事项」: Output possible conditions and departments: at a leaf node it shows "possible conditions, recommended departments, precautions", and you can one-click copy the key points on the result page for easy description at a visit.
map.识别紧急信号：当路径命中高危特征（如剧烈头痛伴呕吐、胸痛、呼吸困难、意识障碍等）: Recognize emergency signals: when the path hits high-risk features (e.g. severe headache with vomiting, chest pain, breathing difficulty, impaired consciousness), the result shows a red "🚨 Possibly urgent" warning and advises seeking care immediately or calling 120.
map.选「头痛」→ 问答：是否突发剧烈？是否伴发热？是否视物模糊？按回答分流：伴发热多: Choose "headache" → Q&A: sudden and severe? with fever? blurred vision? Branch by answer: with fever usually points to a cold/flu; a sudden thunderclap pain needs to rule out a cerebrovascular event (flagged urgent); an ordinary migraine suggests neurology or symptomatic rest. The result page gives possible conditions + department + precautions.
map.症状自查能替代医生诊断吗？: Can a symptom self-check replace a doctor's diagnosis?
map.不能。它是基于常见规律的初步分流参考，帮助判断「大概去哪个科、是否要尽快就医」，: No. It is a preliminary triage reference based on common patterns that helps judge "roughly which department and whether to seek care soon", and cannot replace an in-person consultation, physical exam or tests. If symptoms worsen or persist, seek care promptly.
map.结果提示紧急怎么办？: What if the result flags an emergency?
map.立即就医或拨打 120，不要自行观察拖延。高危信号（剧烈胸痛、呼吸困难、意识障碍: Seek care immediately or call 120; do not delay by observing on your own. High-risk signals (severe chest pain, breathing difficulty, impaired consciousness, sudden severe headache, etc.) may involve a life-threatening situation.
map.症状自查决策树是一款健康医疗领域的在线工具。健康指标计算工具，基于权威医学标准，: The Symptom Self-Check Decision Tree is an online health/medical tool. A health-metric calculation tool based on authoritative medical standards, with all data processed locally to protect privacy.
